known_conflicts_and_resolution.remaining: Exact payment date is not identified; issuer report gives a payment window only.

known_conflicts_and_resolution.basis: Issuer filing sets record date 2026-06-05 and payment within seven days after the 2026-06-19 AGM; the annual report confirms ₹6 per share but no exact payment date was found.
known_conflicts_and_resolution.consequence: Dividend receivable cannot be converted to cash on an invented date; affected accounting evaluation remains blocked.

duplicate_representation_policy: Four NSE/BSE pairs with matching identity, event group, dates and terms are one economic event each. Keep exchange source rows for provenance; count each event once in portfolio accounting.
coverage_limitations: The provider response explicitly makes no completeness guarantee.
The symbol-bound NSE endpoint returned 20 rows versus 21 provider economic groups; the 2010 provider action lacks matching rows in this response.
The NSE response omits record dates for older events where recDate is '-'; the audit preserves those as unresolved rather than filling from provider-only values.
Exact payment dates remain unresolved for all 17 dividend economic events; available issuer statements provide periods or no date.
No evidence of merger, buyback or delisting in the provider response is not proof those actions did not occur.
Corporate-action coverage is limited to one issuer and selected source documents; it is not a complete market-wide or point-in-time event universe.

accounting_review.bonus_2024: Verified 1:1 ratio and record date 2024-10-28; NSE allotment notice states allotment on 2024-10-29. Existing share, cost-basis and stop/target transformations are regression-tested; exact event is not inserted into canonical action manifest.
accounting_review.dividends: Model requires INR amount, eligibility dates and exact payment date. Verified amount/currency/record dates do not establish actual payment date; do not credit cash on a guessed day.
accounting_review.rights_and_demerger: Known event terms are preserved for audit, but unsupported ledger treatment blocks any overlapping evaluation.
accounting_review.future_information: Audit evidence is used only for readiness and event-date application; it does not authorize retroactive signals or a real-data performance run.

acceptance_criteria: Reconcile the 2010 provider event and every missing NSE record date against a symbol-bound issuer/exchange filing or retain explicit unresolved status.
For every dividend, archive a primary issuer/exchange source proving actual payment date or keep the corresponding period blocked.
Implement and test rights cash-call/entitlement accounting and demerger security/cost-basis allocation using verified event terms, or retain the affected evaluation block.
Establish completeness of issuer actions from issuer/exchange history over the full evaluation interval, including action types absent from the provider feed.
Keep historical cost, session/data-integrity and point-in-time universe gates satisfied independently before any backtest readiness decision.
